text:
maria: Heads up — we started seeing a flapping eviction loop in us-west2 around 17:30 UTC. ~200 small GPU pods got evicted, then rescheduled, then evicted again. Looks tied to attach/detach failures on the new NVMe-to-GPU attach shim.

ravi: Saw that too. Node kubelet logs show `AttachVolume.Attach failed` followed by `DetachVolume.Detached succeeded` then immediate reattach attempt.

sophie: Any recent infra changes in us-west2? I only see a kernel patch rolled last night to the node image.

maria: Yes, kernel update rolled to a subset of racks. Affected nodes have the new kernel + our nic driver 1.8.3.

eric: Ops-bot created INC-2026 for this.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026 created (sev:high). Paging oncall.

jamie: Can you paste a short log snippet? Also are these pods using `volumeMode: Block` or CSI attach on the GPU side?

ravi:
```
Jul 14 17:29:02 node-32 kubelet[1234]: E07014 17:29:02.123 attach_detach.go:121] AttachVolume.Attach failed for volume "nvme-gpu-123" : rpc error: code = Unknown desc = attach failed: timeout
Jul 14 17:29:02 node-32 kubelet[1234]: I07014 17:29:02.124 detach.go:45] DetachVolume.Detached volume "nvme-gpu-123"
Jul 14 17:29:03 node-32 kubelet[1234]: I07014 17:29:03.001 pod_manager.go:67] Re-scheduling pod redwood-worker-abc onto node-32
Jul 14 17:29:03 node-32 kubelet[1234]: E07014 17:29:03.110 pod_eviction.go:98] Evicting pod redwood-worker-abc: pod failed to attach storage
```

sophie: That pattern (attach timeout -> detach -> immediate backfill) is the root cause of the thrash. Scheduler backfills immediately and the node still hasn't recovered from the underlying attach problem.

maria: Right. This is compounding because our scheduler aggressively binpacks small GPU pods onto warm nodes (to save cost). Backfill + immediate reschedule => repeated attach attempts.

eric: Short-term mitigation: stop scheduling new GPU pods onto the affected nodes. Can we mark nodes with a taint `redwood/attach-problem=true:NoSchedule` via label selector for affected racks?

jamie: I can do that. Proposing a runbook step:
- label nodes: `kubectl label node node-32 redwood/attach-problem=true`
- taint nodes: `kubectl taint nodes node-32 redwood/attach-problem=true:NoSchedule`
- then cordon/drain non-critical pods.

sophie: Also add a scheduler cool-down to avoid immediate backfills for 60s after an eviction on that node. We have a scheduler plugin flag that can be tuned: `--backfill-cooldown-seconds=60`.

maria: If we do that, we reduce churn but risk leaving usable capacity idle for a minute. Cost wise that's probably fine vs constant attach retries.

ravi: For the mid-term fix: upstream NVMe attach shim is reverting the kernel change. Ops will coordinate a rollback for the kernel on the affected rack.

jamie: I've run the taint+label on 6 nodes in us-west2-r1. Evictions stopped for now, and pods stabilized on other racks.

eric: Good. Can we also add a quick admission/tolerance tweak: set a pod annotation `redwood/eviction-delay: 30s` that the scheduler reads to delay requeueing into that node for X seconds? Low-risk change to the scheduler cache.

sophie: We can implement the annotation check in the scheduler's predicate plugin. Patch idea:
- on pod eviction record node->eviction_ts
- if candidate node had eviction within `eviction-delay`, deprioritize or skip

maria: Works for me. Patch should be behind a feature flag.

ops-bot: Deployment triggered: infra/rollback-kernel-us-west2 (job 4578).

ravi: Note: some pods are on spot-backed nodes. The thrash is causing autoscaler churn and extra spin-up which is increasing cost by ~15% in the region this window.

eric: Add cost note to incident: cost-impact ~+15% for the last 2 hours, will include in postmortem.

maria: For immediate monitoring: I've added a dashboard with attach_failures / evictions / node_tainted_count and an alert if attach_failures > 5/min.

jamie: TL;DR -- mitigations applied: taint + cordon affected nodes, backfill-cooldown set to 60s in canary schedulers, incident created, kernel rollback in progress, scheduler patch planned behind FF.

sophie: Follow-up actions:
- rollback kernel on affected racks (ops) — in progress
- implement eviction-delay scheduler plugin (eng-platform) — PR target EOD
- add alert and dashboard (maria) — done
- postmortem and cost analysis (eng + finance) — owner: eric

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll keep updates here. :thumbsup:
